manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Compare a tossed ball passing through zero velocity at its top with a ball dropped from rest at that same instant.
manifest.description: Two side-by-side lanes track a tossed ball and a released ball. Blue velocity arrows and dashed acceleration arrows show how gravity acts continuously, keeping acceleration constant even when velocity is zero.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
